description: Defines constants, enums, and structs related to Scheduling Request (SR) configuration in 3GPP NR (5G) specifications, including resource IDs, periodicity, timers, and maximum transmission parameters.

classes.name: scheduling_request_to_addmod
classes.description: Represents a scheduling request addition/modification with ID, optional prohibit timer, and max transmission count.

classes.name: scheduling_request_resource_config
classes.description: Represents the configuration of a scheduling request resource, including resource ID, associated request ID, periodicity, offset, and PUCCH resource.

methods.name: uint_to_sched_req_id
methods.description: Converts an unsigned integer to a scheduling_request_id enum.

methods.name: sr_periodicity_to_slot
methods.description: Converts sr_periodicity enum to its corresponding slot value.

methods.name: to_sr_prohib_timer
methods.description: Converts an unsigned value to an sr_prohib_timer enum, with error handling for invalid values.

methods.name: to_sr_max_tx
methods.description: Converts an unsigned value to an sr_max_tx enum, with error handling for invalid values.
